title: Ideaverse Discover - Not My Life
logline: My camera roll from a life I never lived.

raw.spec: 720x1600, variable frame rate, 220.02 s, 1578 frames, silent; fetched by scripts/fetch_sources.sh

shots.desc: 3D phone close-up on real scrolled Discover grid; camera dives into tile r4c1 and lands inside the opening-character slot.
Black typography card 'NEVER HAPPENED.' (0.5 s, text present every frame).
Superhook-motion slot full-bleed: 0.5 s held in-point, then real motion from 4.000 s; recedes upward into depth from 5.5 s.
Reveal 01 card, teal caustic editorial environment, crane-down push.
Real Discover grid scroll (raw recording, real time), pull-out from tile r2c1, push into tile r4c2.
Reveal 02 card, match-cut from tile r4c2, 3/4 angle truck, neon bokeh + rain + floor reflection, whip-out.
Reveal 03 card in deep space, edge-on spin-in with dolly-zoom, embers, push-through.
Reverse perspective: 3D phone (real recording texture) floats inside the payoff world layer with floating result cards.
'Which life would you pick?' while the camera pushes back toward the opening composition; frame 749 flows into frame 0.

payoff-spaceship.aspectNote: 9:16 world plate. Rendered as a camera-locked backdrop with parallax (zoom 1.18-1.3, offset from camera azimuth/elevation) and depth blur, so any 9:16 plate >=1440x2560 drops in. Replacement: Flow spaceship interior, clean, no people needed in the centre (the phone covers it).
payoff-spaceship.mapping: slotFrame = 12 + ((f - 480) mod 750)  -> f480=12 ... f749=281, f0=282 ... f53=335 (continues across the loop seam)
